Name: Kitchen Redone
Author: peachitto
Description:
in updating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1058]my old Furniture Redone mod[/url]﻿, i noticed there had actually been some interest in the kitchen from the screenshots. so i finally bothered to make it into its own mod. :'D so this is exactly that, plus a lighter version to match some of the other, slightly newer, furniture recolors i did. as of 1.1 there is also a matching minifridge replacement.

what's configurable?
[list]
[*][b]the wood color[/b]: dark or light
[*][b]farmhouse kitchen, island kitchen, crib[/b]: true or false
[*][b]the minifridge[/b]: true or false

[/list]
as i said in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12940]my update to the furniture[/url] for my initial mod, i don't have any interest in continuing creating with this palette/style. i only upload this because it was basically done! :'D so no fireplace, no walls, floors, etc. if i do create anymore furniture/interior stuff it will be different. thank you for understanding~

Downloads.Description: 1.1 - added missing texture for animation when opening the fridge; added optional matching minifridge replacement
